rationale: Tony and Aditya both specialize in embedded systems and microcontroller programming, with overlapping tech stacks (C++, STM32) and deep experience in low-level systems. Aditya is actively deploying AI and reinforcement learning on resource-constrained edge devices like the ESP32, while Tony's firmware and FPGA expertise could directly support the embedded AI challenges Aditya is tackling in robotics and prosthetics applications.
